content: Mañjuśrī, subduer of the demon-enemy,I explain the secret pith instruction to repel the demon.Externally, do not let what appears hold power over you;Internally, the waves of conceptual thought are turbulent.Whatever greatly contradicts the path of Dharma,Moving without control, is the sign of a demon.Once recognized, strive to repel it;At the crown of the head, all refuges are gathered.Meditate on the Guru and Yidam as inseparable;Accumulate merit, pray, and mingle your mind with theirs.At the heart, upon a moon and vajra,The seed-syllable and mantra rays of light—The fire of primordial wisdom blazes, burning your own body;Contemplate emptiness, and from that state,Meditate on yourself as the Yidam deity;View all of existence as like an illusion.With love that is equal toward all,In the manner of all-pervading white light rays,Imagine all beings possess supreme happiness;Everything is the dynamic energy of one's own mind, rigpa.Rest in the unaltered, innate rigpa,Free from fabrication, causes, conditions, center, or edge.In the state of fresh, empty, and lucid non-grasping,Remain in a manner free from negation or affirmation.Be completely victorious over the maras of obstacles,And you shall attain the supreme and common accomplishments.Samaya. Written on the eighth day of the eleventh month at the old Dzongsar monastery.
